scope.request: Fix repeated squad-cohesion reads and make the actual 1x placement tests pass without raising performance limits.
scope.time_driver: RearSimulation.advance_time and global settlement remain. No scheduler, timer cadence, recipe, capacity, opening or start-position change. Live wall-clock background pumping is coalesced per engine process frame; explicit-delta stepping remains unchanged.
scope.fingerprint_scope: Source-anchor file_sha256 values use the living map newline-normalized content fingerprint; raw_file_sha256 and launcher source manifests are byte hashes. Function fingerprints are the map implementation hashes.

implementation.cohesion: Fresh roster-level scalar counts replace two detailed-person exports per active member. The same eligibility and 30-metre inclusivity rules remain; immediate movement/health/boarding effects and dispersion timestamps are not deferred or cached.
implementation.membership: Canonical ledger membership queries return only fresh ordered IDs; no persistent relationship index or invalidation mechanism was introduced.
implementation.ammunition: One fresh scan counts the initial per-squad loose/loaded ammunition view with the scalar query rules. Later shot checks still read current state.
implementation.mounted_weapons: Idle/future reload commitments do not export hulls. Due reloads retain actual crew/rack checks. Rack quantities use the existing canonical scalar query; source selection inspects only the local stock subset.
implementation.frame_coordination: GameSession skips duplicate live wall-clock pumps in the same Engine.get_process_frames ID. BaseSimulation accrues the entire elapsed interval on its next pump or speed change; replacement resets the scene-owned gate. Explicit-delta models retain every physics callback.
implementation.diagnostics: Opt-in TRENCHO_PROFILE_STAGES=1 records inclusive service, policy, execution, ammunition, collection, per-person and route scope durations. It is off in final placement runs; full existing caller-stack capture remains on.
implementation.native_test_strengthening: Placement phases now verify actual 1x logical progress within 0.25 seconds of wall elapsed time and at most 0.25 seconds of outstanding simulation debt. No existing timing or inspection budget was relaxed.

retained_regressions.session_test_update: The unchanged old session test failed the obsolete resource-central expectation on both pre-task and fixed builds. Current Farmland declares resource-centre-blue/red and seven other objectives. The test now verifies every authored objective, the actual empty-field opening and replacement through Main._start_playtest, while preserving hidden-view clock, pause, identity and audit checks.

summary.cohesion_cost_guard: 100 reads require 100 fresh count queries and zero inspect_entity exports; the old healthy eight-person path exported 16 detailed people per assessment.
summary.performance_interpretation: Bounded runs on the installed Godot 4.7.2 system, with live 1x progress and unchanged instrumentation/limits. Frame intervals include rendering/scheduling and are not script CPU attribution or a statistical guarantee for all hardware/states.

iteration_evidence.finding: Cohesion-only change preserved behavior but default placement still had three timing failures.
Opt-in substep timings attributed the remaining initial decision burst; no limits were raised.

A conservative terrain row-prefilter experiment did not improve this stall. Terrain source was restored to its exact pre-task SHA256 and that experimental test was removed; no terrain behavior change remains.
Frame coordination let placement workflows pass but the no-building control still failed near 102.5 ms; unused mounted-hull/rack exports were subsequently removed.

fixture_corrections.issue: New ammunition fixture called a nonexistent consumption API.
Replacement fixture used a place-only consumption API with a person holder.
Fixture passed an untyped empty array to a typed roster API.

fixture_corrections.resolution: The passing current guard uses actual load/fire operations and a correctly typed empty roster; no expected gameplay values or frozen baselines were changed.

remaining_limits: Full 47-case default suite and the broader UI/building matrix were not rerun in this fix; their previously recorded new-game/cancellation/menu timing issues remain open until revalidated.
The global dispatcher/settlement design, other broad advanced-panel reads and later-game performance remain overhaul work.
Native pointer scenarios cover the default opening and these bounded 1x actions; they do not certify every building, arbitrary late-game state or every function.
Pause and 2x tests verify time accounting; sustained full-world 2x frame/progress performance was not certified by the 1x native placement runs.

references.use: Measure identified costs, recheck after each change and discard ineffective optimizations.
A process-frame identifier advances even with the render loop disabled and can coordinate repeated expensive calls.

log_availability: Raw isolated reports and comparison copies are local ignored artifacts. This record preserves hashes and bounded results without assuming raw logs exist in a fresh checkout.
